pairs: Cum ergo natus esset Jesus in Bethlehem Juda in diebus Herodis regis,
And so, when Jesus had been born in Bethlehem of Judah, in the days of king Herod,
ecce magi ab oriente venerunt Jerosolymam,
behold, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
Ubi est qui natus est rex Judæorum?
“Where is he who was born king of the Jews?
vidimus enim stellam ejus in oriente,
For we have seen his star in the east,
and we have come to adore him.”
And gathering together all the leaders of the priests,
and the scribes of the people,
sciscitabatur ab eis ubi Christus nasceretur.
he consulted with them as to where the Christ would be born.
sic enim scriptum est per prophetam:
For so it has been written by the prophet:
‘And you, Bethlehem, the land of Judah,
nequaquam minima es in principibus Juda:
are by no means least among the leaders of Judah.
ex te enim exiet dux, qui regat populum meum Israël.
For from you shall go forth the ruler who shall guide my people Israel.’”
Tunc Herodes clam vocatis magis diligenter didicit ab eis tempus stellæ, quæ apparuit eis:
Then Herod, quietly calling the Magi, diligently learned from them the time when the star appeared to them.
“Go and diligently ask questions about the boy.
And when you have found him,
And when they had heard the king,
the star that they had seen in the east went before them,
it stood still above the place where the child was.
Videntes autem stellam gavisi sunt gaudio magno valde.
Then, seeing the star, they were gladdened by a very great joy.
invenerunt puerum cum Maria matre ejus,
they found the boy with his mother Mary. And so,
et apertis thesauris suis obtulerunt ei munera,
And opening their treasures, they offered him gifts: gold,
Et responso accepto in somnis ne redirent ad Herodem,
And having received a response in sleep that they should not return to Herod,
per aliam viam reversi sunt in regionem suam.
they went back by another way to their own region.
And after they had gone away,
ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph,
an Angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph,
and take the boy and his mother,
et esto ibi usque dum dicam tibi.
And remain there until I tell you.
Futurum est enim ut Herodes quærat puerum ad perdendum eum.
For it will happen that Herod will seek the boy to destroy him.”
he took the boy and his mother by night,
et erat ibi usque ad obitum Herodis:
And he remained there, until the death of Herod,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est a Domino per prophetam dicentem:
in order to fulfill what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying:
“Out of Egypt, I called my son.”
Tunc Herodes videns quoniam illusus esset a magis,
seeing that he had been fooled by the Magi,
And so he sent to kill all the boys who were in Bethlehem,
a bimatu et infra secundum tempus,
from two years of age and under,
according to the time that he had learned by questioning the Magi.
Tunc adimpletum est quod dictum est per Jeremiam prophetam dicentem:
Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled, saying:
Vox in Rama audita est ploratus,
“A voice has been heard in Ramah,
And she was not willing to be consoled,
Then, when Herod had passed away,
ecce angelus Domini apparuit in somnis Joseph in Ægypto,
behold, an Angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph in Egypt,
and go into the land of Israel.
defuncti sunt enim qui quærebant animam pueri.
For those who were seeking the life of the boy have passed away.”
and he went into the land of Israel.
Audiens autem quod Archelaus regnaret in Judæa pro Herode patre suo,
Then, hearing that Archelaus reigned in Judea in place of his father Herod,
he was afraid to go there.
he withdrew into parts of Galilee.
Et veniens habitavit in civitate quæ vocatur Nazareth:
And arriving, he lived in a city which is called Nazareth,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetas:
in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophets:
“For he shall be called a Nazarene.”
